title: His children: a clarinetist son and singer son Paul Tate
summary: Tate talks about his daughters, a son with mental illness who plays clarinet, and Paul Tate's Capitol album.

story.theme_name: Meeting, marrying and raising a family
story.community_name: Talking about my children and grandchildren
